roofers.name: Roofers
roofers.intro: Re-roofs, slipped tiles, flat roofs, leadwork, chimneys, fascias and gutters.
tips: Ask for the guarantee in writing. New tiled or slate roofs often come with 10 to 20 years; flat roofs usually match the membrane's own warranty.
Check public liability insurance is current. Directory profiles sometimes show it as unverified.
A roof survey usually costs £80 to £150 locally and is often free if you go ahead with the work.
For scaffolding on a pavement, the roofer or scaffolder needs a council licence. Ask who is arranging it.

driveways.name: Driveway companies
driveways.intro: Block paving, resin bound, tarmac, gravel, patios and dropped kerbs.
tips: Front garden over 5 square metres? A new hard surface must be permeable (resin bound, permeable blocks or gravel) or drain to a lawn or border, otherwise you need planning permission.
A dropped kerb needs Oxfordshire County Council approval before any work starts on the pavement.
Block paving driveways in this area typically come in around £3,800 for an average drive, or roughly £100 per square metre. Get two or three written quotes.
Ask what goes underneath: depth of sub-base and type of membrane matter more than the surface you see.

plumbers.name: Plumbers and heating engineers
plumbers.intro: Boiler installs and repairs, servicing, leaks, bathrooms, cylinders and landlord gas certificates.
tips: Any gas work must be done by a Gas Safe registered engineer. Check their number on the official Gas Safe Register before they start.
A gas boiler service costs around £80 to £120 locally.
Landlords need a gas safety certificate (CP12) every 12 months.
For a new boiler, ask which manufacturer warranty you get and whether it needs a yearly service to stay valid.
